content: Streak design best practices: 1) Build Grace Periods from day one (1 missed day/month). 2) Recovery Quests preserve dignity - short challenge to restore broken streak. 3) 7-day capped cycles better than infinite counters (psychological weight ≤ 7 days). 4) Transition from daily pressure to permanent status at day 30+. 5) Never monetize streak anxiety (Duolingo trap). 6) Capped streaks outperform infinite for long-term retention.
